scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.lint:launch: python -m ruff check --select E9,F63,F7,F82 artifacts/legal-luminaire/backend scripts && python -m ruff check --select E4,E7,E9,F,B023 scripts/test_launch_browser.py
scripts.launch:gate: pnpm run lint:launch && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/legal-luminaire run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/legal-luminaire run build && cd artifacts/legal-luminaire/backend && python -m pytest -q tests
